about: Editing styles: the house rules a reel is cut by. The director picks the one that fits the creator and the content; code holds the reel to it. effects = the signature effects this style reaches for (data/effects.json names), max_effects = how many one reel may use; caption_looks = the caption looks it rotates (render.CAPTION_LOOKS); text_styles = caption styles it allows (first is its default); moods = music moods it allows (first is its default); graphic_every = seconds of output per story graphic. Caption styles are the ones read while someone talks, so the thin editorial look is kept for titles only.

podcast.title: Podcast / interview
podcast.when: two or more people talking, long conversations, interviews, talk shows

hype.title: Hype / energetic
hype.when: high-energy creators, challenges, reactions, gaming, sports, bold opinions

education.title: Education / explainer
education.when: teaching, explaining, tutorials, how-to, science, history, health advice

business.title: Business / finance
business.when: money, startups, careers, marketing, investing, productivity

vlog.title: Vlog / lifestyle
vlog.when: day in the life, travel, family, personal stories, lifestyle

food.title: Food / cooking
food.when: recipes, cooking, eating, restaurants, street food

calm.title: Calm / devotional
calm.when: spiritual talks, meditation, poetry, slow and reflective content
